19:13.text: sympathetic to men as a mercy
from Us, and pure from sins

19:14.text: And dutiful towards his parents, and he was neither arrogant nor disobedient

19:15.text: be on him the day he was born, and the day he dies, and the day he will be raised up to life

19:16.text: (the Qur’ân, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم the story of)
, when she withdrew in seclusion from her family to a place facing east.

19:17.text: from them; then We sent to her Our Ruh
, and he appeared before her in the form of a man in all respects.

19:18.text: She said: "Verily! I seek refuge with the Most Gracious
from you, if you do fear Allâh."

19:19.text: said: "I am only a messenger from your Lord,
to you the gift of a righteous son."

19:20.text: She said: "How can I have a son, when no man has touched me, nor am I unchaste?"

19:21.text: , your Lord said: ‘That is easy for Me
to appoint him as a sign to mankind and a mercy from Us

19:22.text: and she withdrew with him to a far place
(i.e. Bethlehem valley about 4-6 miles from Jerusalem)

19:23.text: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a date-palm. She said: "Would that I had died before this, and had been forgotten and out of sight!"

19:24.text: cried unto her from below her, saying: "Grieve not: your Lord has provided a water stream under you.

19:25.text: "And shake the trunk of date-palm towards you, it will let fall fresh ripe-dates upon you."
